name: lost-and-found
description: Lost & Found สำหรับมหาวิทยาลัย — Vue 3 + Tailwind CSS + Neon (Postgres)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:e2e: concurrently -n E2E-API,E2E-WEB -c yellow,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev -- --port 5175 --strictPort"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix client run test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix server run test:coverage && npm --prefix client run test:coverage
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build
